questions.text:
Refer to Text A, "Teen Spirit", on page 2 of the resource booklet.

Discuss how the writer explores the ways people experience their environment, referring to at least TWO specific aspects of written texts.
questions.markingGuide:
ACHIEVEMENT (3-4 marks): Develop a relevant critical discussion in response to the question, showing engagement with the text. Make and evaluate a range of relevant points showing understanding of how at least TWO aspects of the text have been crafted to create meaning. Include specific and relevant details from the text to support the discussion.

MERIT (5-6 marks): Develop a convincing critical discussion showing informed engagement with the text. Make and evaluate relevant points showing convincing understanding of how at least TWO aspects have been crafted to create meaning. Begin to weave specific details from the text into the response to effectively support the discussion. Potentially link points to matters beyond the text.

EXCELLENCE (7-8 marks): Develop a sophisticated or original critical discussion showing insightful engagement with the text. Make and evaluate relevant points showing perceptive understanding of how at least TWO aspects have been crafted to create meaning. Weave specific and judiciously chosen details into the response to effectively support and expand the discussion. Trace the development of ideas throughout the text and link points to other contexts such as human experience, society, and the wider world.

Relevant aspects might include: audiences and purposes; ideas (e.g. insecurity/security, enjoyment, growth, learning, careful observation, friendship); language features/structures (e.g. anthropomorphism/personification, become a mum, emotive language, collapsing, exhausted, intimidating; comparison, fresh to island/later; personal pronouns, I have come to understand; repeated motif, sleeping human/sleeping sea lion; dialogue, advice on environment).

questions.text:
Refer to BOTH Text A and Text B.

Discuss the relationships between people and animals, referring to at least TWO specific aspects of written texts. You may refer to one or both texts in your response.
